## Assigning Brand ID and Campaign ID to 10DLC Number

1. Navigate to **Assets** > **Numbers** > **Get Numbers**.
2. Select **Phone Number** from the list.
3. (Optional) In the **Buy - Phone Number** page, do the following to find a number:
   1. In the **Country** drop-down menu, select **United States**.
   2. In the **Number Type** drop-down menu, select **Landline**.
   3. In the **Features** drop-down menu, select **SMS**.
   4. Enter a value to search by **Area Code **or **Location**, and click **Find Numbers** to search for a number.
4. In the Numbers page, click **Actions** and select **Request 10DLC** to select the Brand and Campaign ID to assign to the number.

> 📘 
> 
> If you do not have a US landline (10DLC) number, you can order one by following steps (1-4) in the procedure above. If you require more information about phone numbers and the types of phone numbers, refer to [Buy Phone Number section](https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/phone-numbers#buy-numbers-for-the-united-states). <<WebexCC>>customers/partners are required to follow step 3 above to ensure that 10DLC functions as expected.

The Brand ID and Campaign ID you include while adding a US landline number with SMS feature, will now display on the <<prodname>> platform when you hover over 10DLC associated with the number on the Number listing page.

## Removing a 10DLC number from Campaign ID

To remove 10DLC number:

1. Go to Assets > Numbers.

[block:image]
{
  "images": [
    {
      "image": [
        "https://files.readme.io/bc84117-10.png",
        null,
        "Screenshot displaying the List of Numbers."
      ],
      "align": "center",
      "border": true,
      "caption": "Screenshot displaying the List of Numbers."
    }
  ]
}
[/block]


2. Select the required number and click **Manage** under **Actions**.  
   Manage Phone Number page appears.

[block:image]
{
  "images": [
    {
      "image": [
        "https://files.readme.io/b3af224-Remove10DLC1.png",
        null,
        "Screenshot displaying to Select the Manage Button."
      ],
      "align": "center",
      "border": true,
      "caption": "Screenshot displaying to Select the Manage Button."
    }
  ]
}
[/block]


3. Click Remove 10DLC Assignment to release the number.

[block:image]
{
  "images": [
    {
      "image": [
        "https://files.readme.io/4963cb1-Introducing_Numbers1.png",
        null,
        "Screenshot Displaying to Select the Remove 10DLC Assignment."
      ],
      "align": "center",
      "border": true,
      "caption": "Screenshot Displaying to Select the Remove 10DLC Assignment."
    }
  ]
}
[/block]


A warning appears: 10DLC Assignment is successfully removed. Once the number is de-provisioned, the "Remove 10DLC Assignment" is not displayed.

## Introduction of Number Status

Currently, when a number is assigned to 10 DLC, user only sees the blue “10DLC“ label if the number is successfully assigned. From now on, multiple statuses regarding the assignment are displayed such as - Success, Pending, Failed.

This feature is applicable only for US Landline numbers.
